title.narrative: Multi-sectoral assistance to IDPs, returnees and non-displaced conflict-affected people to ensure their safety and dignity, as well as access to basic services, in the east and north of Ukraine

description.narrative: ltpgtThe war that began in Ukraine in February 2024 and humanitarian crisis that followed it continue to impact the lives of millions of people in the country and cause damage on a massive scale.ltbrgtApproximately 17.6M people in Ukraine require multi-sectoral humanitarian assistance. These include 6.3M IDPs, 4.4M returnees and 6.9M people who did not leave their homes during the war.ltbrgtChanges and negative trends have appeared in all social spheres. The country's loss of territory, active military operations at the front and attacks on civilians and infrastructure do not contribute to maintaining a more or less stable situation and threaten security. In turn, the closure of enterprises, small and medium-sized businesses, the destruction of agricultural infrastructure and the closure of markets led to a huge loss of jobs and sources of regular income for millions of citizens across the country. There are also disruptions in social services, health care and education. The protracted economic crisis still does not allow the state at this stage to provide full support to the population and cover urgent needs.ltbrgtDamage to water supply networks and infrastructure, as well as regular power outages and limited capacity for repairs, have left more than 1M people across Ukraine without adequate access to safe water, hygiene products, and waste treatment. The limited number of drinking water supply points, in addition to damaged water supply systems, are significant obstacles to the distributing water by water services. There continues to be demand for hygiene products that meet specific needs, such as family hygiene and hygiene products for PwD.ltbrgtThe project aims to provide vital supplies and targeted, time-critical assistance. To address identified needs and existing gaps, NW proposes to implement the following activities:ltbrgt- hard and medium repair ltbrgt- solid fuel distribution ltbrgt- distribution of hygiene Family and PSN kitsltbrgt- water trucking ltbrgt- distributing bottled waterltbrgt- repair of WASH facilities in HCFsltbrgt- repair of rural water systems, incl. water towers and boreholesltbrgt- supporting vodokanals with materials (pipes, valves, clamps, etc.) and equipment (welding, pumps, spare parts for machinery, etc.), necessary for emergency repairs, OM of water and sewage systems ltbrgt- distribution of garbage tanks for SWM supportltbrgtTotal number of people targeted is 163587 individuals, incl. 18771 PwDltbrgtNW is a national NGO supported affected people since 2016. The project will be implemented in partnership with local NGO ChF "EAST UKRAINIAN DIASPORA" (EUD), to supplement resources of each partner and provide comprehensive assistance ltbrgtNW will be the leading agency with the following duties:ltbrgt- compiling program documents, incl. Logframe, Workplan, etc.ltbrgt- overall coordination and management of the project implementationltbrgt- procurement of goodsltbrgt- delivery of goods to project locationsltbrgt- collecting and verification of beneficiaries` personal dataltbrgt- distributing hygiene kits, solid fuel, materials and equipment for OM water, sewage systems and SWMltbrgt- carrying out repair water systems, HCFs and private HHsltbrgt- reporting to UHF and Clustersltbrgt- monitoring the progress of project implementation and evaluating resultsltbrgtEUD will be the implementing partner. Oganization has satisfactory experience in distributing more than 60000 food, WASH, NFI kits, incl. cooperation with UN agencies (WFP, UNHCR, UNICEF) and NGOs (R2P, ADRA)ltbrgtWithin the framework of the project EUD will perform the following duties:ltbrgt- conducting a needs assessmentltbrgt- collecting and verification of beneficiaries` personal data ltbrgt- distributing hygiene kits in Dnipropetrovska oblastltbrgt- procurement and distributing bottled waterltbrgtMore information on partners obligations can be found in the Logframe tab. ltbrgtBoth NGOs are aware of local context and humanitarian principles.ltbrgtAnalysis of potential risks has been conducted and mitigation measures have been elaborated. ltbrgtThe proposed interventions align with Allocation Strategy, HRP 2024 Strategic and Clusters Objectives.lt/pgt
